pages.title: Quick Start
pages.text: $(bold)Place coil. Light with Flint and Steel.$()$(li)Radius: $(thing)8 blocks$()$(li)Burn time: $(thing)10 minutes$()$(li)Right-click with an empty hand to snuff it and save the rest of the burn$(li)A fresh MiteAway on a lit unit refreshes it; units do not stack$(br2)Frostmites only.

pages.title: Limitations
pages.text: $(italic)MiteAway is not a pesticide.$()$(br2)It does not kill Frostmites. Infested blocks nearby still spawn them, but active smoke makes them avoid the room instead of swarming through it.$(br2)Does not guarantee sleep, thermal stability or emotional peace.

pages.title: Testimonials
